method.basis: Manual visual inventory of each complete primary Texts object entry plus enlarged glyph-column crops; numeric sign IDs authenticated against the primary sign inventory. Candidate strings used only as suggestions, never as acceptance evidence.
method.order: Tokens in normalized right-to-left reading order as displayed by Mahadevan Texts.
method.boundaries: Every printed side and line is separate; the selected field line is excluded by exact ID. Metadata continuation rows inherit only the object reference, not a preceding glyph line.
method.symbol_only: Five-digit continuation metadata consists of side, two-digit field-symbol code, line, direction; line9 and direction0 mean no text.
method.uncertainty: LOSS = primary hatched lost passage, *Mddd = primary doubtful sign; UNKNOWN would be visible but unidentified. Full sequence primary checked does not imply intact text.
method.visual_review: Full Texts rows and metadata inspected on PDF129–139,144,146,147. Enlarged glyph-only views were rendered directly to memory from the same PDF; retained full-page image evidence includes all rows and metadata.
